department: Ph.D. Program in Biomedical Sciences, College of Medicine

deadline.value: The page says December 1 of the year before the fall start is the full-consideration date, so for Fall 2027 entry the date is December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: Applications completed by December 1 of the previous year receive full consideration for admission

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies; the department accepts a general graduate test such as the GRE or MCAT.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by a departmental committee; students do three lab rotations in the first year before matching to a lab.
supervisor.quote: Admission decisions are based on a review by the departmental admissions committee

funding.value: The admissions and program pages give no funding terms.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or a graduate degree from a regionally accredited institution meets the minimum.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution | Or a graduate degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable international institution

notes: College of Medicine runs this PhD with its own committee review. Application fee is $30.00 USD and is not waived for graduate applicants (same as the Graduate School). Official GRE or an approved waiver is required.
